ml_orphans_archive_not_deleted: Archived, not deleted: each item stays in its own list and searchable. New work on this project forms a new cluster.
ml_orphans_drafted: Drafted. It waits in Sign for your signature.
ml_orphans_adopted: Adopted. The mandate now holds this project's work.
ml_orphans_archived: {count} items archived from the Orphans lane.
ml_breach_out_widen: The steward may {scope} alone on this mandate. This item and later ones like it stop reaching you.
ml_breach_out_merge: Branches on this mandate merge {policy}, without asking you. A merge cannot be taken back.
ml_breach_out_spend: The monthly cap becomes {cap}, so work held by today's cap can run. Money spent stays spent.
ml_breach_out_deny: {effect} The reason you pick is recorded and the mandate stays as it is.
ml_breach_out_suspend: Every item of the {project} mandate waits, held, until you resume it. This item stays undecided.
ml_breach_state_unsigned: The {project} mandate is unsigned, so its steward decides nothing alone and every item it holds comes to you. Signing it would let the steward decide the kinds you grant, and items like this one would stop reaching you.
ml_breach_state_none: {project} has no mandate, so nothing is delegated and there is no envelope to amend or suspend. Items like this one gather in the Orphans lane (O), where a mandate can be drafted or adopted.
ml_breach_state_no_project: No project and no mandate hold this item, so nothing is delegated and there is no envelope to amend or suspend.
ml_breach_state_unread: This item's mandate did not load, so amend and suspend wait until it does.
ml_breach_amend_item_hint_none: Decides this item only; no mandate covers it
ml_reread_yes: The envelope stays as signed. This card comes back only once the mandate's acts have doubled and its use asks again.
ml_reread_no: Press E first: the edited envelope is signed and binds from the next item; the change lands in the act log and can be reverted there.
